description: Get the connected Shopify store's automation settings: browse abandonment (emails shoppers who viewed a product but didn't buy), cart abandonment (fires ecommerce.cart_abandoned with the full cart after the cart sits inactive), and price drop alerts (emails recent viewers when a product's price falls). Returns the effective values with platform defaults applied.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_shopify_automation_settings
